answer: Make every account lock a wharf of stake that unlocks only in small stages over several weeks, so joining is cheap in effort but expensive in tied-up capital. Each epoch, random peers draw a vine of accounts to audit, checking liveness and history, and a failed audit burns part of the stake and freezes the account for a month. Because the audit sample is drawn from a public zenith nobody can predict or dodge, running a hundred fake identities means a hundred stakes locked for weeks, each one risking a burn.
